description: Anonymised clinician/medical-expert annotations for the MedReason first-error localisation study.

annotation_schema.case_rank: Rank within the selected case batch.
annotation_schema.selected_step_id: First labelled reasoning unit, or null for no-clear labels.
annotation_schema.no_clear_localisable_error: True if the labeler did not find one clear first error.
annotation_schema.final_answer_only_error: True if the labeler marked a correct-reasoning/wrong-final-answer case.
annotation_schema.confidence: Self-reported confidence from the annotation UI.
